mcqs.question: Solve the inequality 3x - 5 > 7. Which interval correctly represents its solution set?

options.C: All real numbers between -∞ and 4 inclusive

mcqs.explanation: 3x - 5 > 7 ⇒ 3x > 12 ⇒ x > 4. Hence the solution set is (4, ∞), i.e., all real numbers greater than 4. Option B matches this interval. The other options describe incorrect intervals or no solution.

mcqs.question: A company needs a value of x that satisfies 2x + 3 ≤ 15. What is the greatest integer value of x that meets this condition?
mcqs.explanation: 2x + 3 ≤ 15 ⇒ 2x ≤ 12 ⇒ x ≤ 6. The largest integer not exceeding 6 is 6, so option B is correct. Options A, C, and D are either too small or exceed the allowed maximum.

mcqs.learning_point: Represent solutions on a number line
mcqs.question: When graphing the solution of x < -2 on a number line, which of the following is correct?

options.A: Open circle at -2 with shading to the left
options.B: Closed circle at -2 with shading to the left
options.C: Open circle at -2 with shading to the right
options.D: Closed circle at -2 with shading to the right

mcqs.answer: Open circle at -2 with shading to the left
mcqs.explanation: x < -2 excludes -2, so an open circle is used, and the shading extends leftward toward smaller numbers. Option A reflects this. Options B and D incorrectly include -2, and option C shades the wrong direction.

mcqs.question: Solve the compound inequality -3 ≤ 2x - 1 < 5 and express the solution in interval notation.
mcqs.explanation: Add 1: -2 ≤ 2x < 6. Divide by 2: -1 ≤ x < 3. In interval notation this is [-1,3). Option B matches. Option A has wrong endpoints, C represents a union of unrelated intervals, and D excludes the left endpoint incorrectly.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements has the same solution set as the compound inequality 1 < 2x + 3 ≤ 7?
mcqs.explanation: 1 < 2x + 3 ≤ 7 ⇒ -2 < 2x ≤ 4 ⇒ -1 < x ≤ 2, i.e., (-1,2]. Option A gives [-2,2), which includes -2 and excludes 2. Option B gives (0,2], which excludes values between -1 and 0. Neither matches, so D is correct.

mcqs.question: If the solution set of the inequality 4 - 2x > 0 is expressed in interval notation, which choice is correct?
mcqs.explanation: 4 - 2x > 0 ⇒ -2x > -4 ⇒ x < 2. The solution consists of all real numbers less than 2, written as (-∞, 2). Option B matches. Option A reverses the inequality, C incorrectly includes 2, and D represents numbers greater than or equal to 2.

mcqs.question: Solve for x: 5x - 10 ≤ 0.
mcqs.explanation: 5x - 10 ≤ 0 ⇒ 5x ≤ 10 ⇒ x ≤ 2. Hence option B is correct. Options A, C, and D represent the opposite inequality.

mcqs.learning_point: Represent solutions on a number line
mcqs.question: Which diagram correctly represents the solution set x > -3 on a number line?

options.A: Closed circle at -3 with shading to the right
options.B: Open circle at -3 with shading to the left
options.C: Open circle at -3 with shading to the right
options.D: Closed circle at -3 with shading to the left

mcqs.answer: Open circle at -3 with shading to the right
mcqs.explanation: x > -3 excludes -3, so an open circle is used, and shading extends to the right (greater numbers). Option C matches this. Options A and D incorrectly include -3, and B shades the wrong direction.
